candidates.decision_relevance: Would allow the reviews to compare price paths with warning and forecast times, distinguish rebounds from uninterrupted moves, and assess forecast-range containment rather than relying on weekly endpoints or qualitative path descriptions.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews W33–W46 and daily reviews Nov. 17–19 repeatedly lack raw price paths, freeze-time sequences, and numerical forecast bands; some daily inputs contain only a 168-hour ETH/BTC series.
candidates.metric_name: BTC and ETH hourly price paths aligned to recorded analysis freeze times and candidate bounds
candidates.missing_history_problem: Without a historical, timestamp-aligned path, the reviews cannot verify event ordering, hindsight leakage, rebound magnitude, or whether ranges were precise rather than broadly containing outcomes.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would help determine whether reported breadth deterioration or recovery persisted across observations, rather than reflecting a single proxy snapshot or changing point-in-time membership.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews report proxy-only breadth snapshots with changing membership and conflicting observation times; weekly reviews repeatedly lack numerical breadth sequences and methodology.
candidates.metric_name: Dated breadth observations with constituent universe and membership identifiers
candidates.missing_history_problem: The available snapshots do not establish the duration or sequence of participation changes, and their differing universes prevent reliable historical comparison.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether mixed or negative settled BTC and ETH ETF observations persisted, reversed, or diverged across the periods discussed.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews generally cite only one latest settled session or a dated observation; weekly reviews note that settled-flow detail is missing or stale relative to the analysis week.
candidates.metric_name: Dated settled BTC and ETH ETF flow rows with reported units
candidates.missing_history_problem: Isolated settled rows cannot establish a within-period flow sequence or whether flows aligned with price and breadth changes.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would make prior candidate evaluations auditable against the information available when each candidate was formed, while keeping later observations separate from issuance-time evidence.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews repeatedly report missing candidate definitions, issue times, bounds, and linked outcomes; daily reviews supply candidates but note that matured scorecards and candidate-level results are unavailable.
candidates.metric_name: Candidate issuance records linked to frozen evidence snapshots and matured realized paths
candidates.missing_history_problem: Without linked issuance-time evidence and candidate specifications, the supplied matured-outcome counts cannot resolve hindsight leakage, range precision, or candidate-level outcome comparisons.
